sourceText:
Mixed Berry Bone Broth Smoothie
By: Kettle and Fire
Published: Monday, June 12, 2017 - 8:16am

Ingredients




3-4 Kettle & Fire Chicken Bone Broth ice cubes
1 cup mixed berries, rinsed
1 banana, peeled and sliced
¼ cup flaxseeds
½ cup water

Preparation

1 Make bone broth ice cubes the night prior by pouring Kettle and Fire Chicken Bone Broth into an ice tray and freeze it. 2 Place the mixed berries, banana, and flax seeds in a blender with ½ cup of water. Add 3-4 chicken bone broth ice cubes. Blend until smooth. 3 Pour into a glass and enjoy!

About

Blend and enjoy this mixed berry bone broth smoothie, a fruity, bone broth-fortified treat for your skin and body!
